purpose: Public source catalog for issue-discovery research. Entries describe access and review scope; they are not petition cases or confirmation of an underlying policy problem.

sources.review_scope: Published description of complaint collection, monitoring, topic analysis and use in institutional improvement.
sources.discovery_use: Start with recurring complaints and trace their causes to rules or processes.
sources.limits: The internal analysis system and authenticated raw complaint data were not inspected.

sources.review_scope: Public report list and selected passages of issue 878, covering 2026-09-21 through 2026-09-27. Issue 877 was located as an additional monthly source.
sources.discovery_use: Extract questions from recurring requests; compare reports with matched collection scope.
sources.limits: Issue 878 excludes traffic-enforcement complaints. Requests are not institutional findings. Counts do not establish unique people or population prevalence. The separate dashboard at https://bigdata.epeople.go.kr/ had no readable body through web retrieval.

sources.review_scope: Public decisions list and the integrated business-closure recommendation's original decision, problem descriptions and proposed improvements.

sample_document.title: 국민 편익 증진을 위한 통합 폐업신고 확대·강화 방안

sources.discovery_use: Find diagnosed process failures and check whether recommendations have reached implementation.
sources.limits: Recommendation, acceptance and implementation are separate. Current service behavior and compliance were not inspected. Do not republish the complete licensed originals.

sources.review_scope: Administrative Regulations Basic Act Article 7, effective 2026-05-12, and its published analytical criteria.
sources.discovery_use: Review necessity, proportional burdens, duplicate requirements and lower-burden alternatives.
sources.limits: Article 7 covers new or strengthened central-government regulation within its applicable scope. Do not assume every policy or notice requires an identical impact report.

sources.review_scope: Public report categories and impact-analysis titles. Individual reports were not reviewed for substantive findings in this task.
sources.discovery_use: Locate analysis of legal effects and policy alternatives, then inspect the original report.
sources.limits: A report title or recommendation is not proof of the current rule or its effects.

sources.review_scope: Public list and Focus issue 177's stated purpose and staged processing-time analysis. No underlying dataset was recalculated.

sample_document.title: 개인정보 유출사고 관련 재정사업의 효과성 분석과 개선과제

sources.discovery_use: Trace expenditure through program activity to measurable service results.
sources.limits: Budget increases, low execution rates and incident counts do not by themselves establish waste or causation. Preserve the report's sampling and time basis.

sources.review_scope: Definition, justified versus unjustified friction, NSW method and good-practice sections.
sources.discovery_use: Assess unnecessary friction around a defined user goal and measure changes.
sources.limits: International use does not establish effectiveness for a particular Korean service. Confirm local facts and necessary checks.

sources.review_scope: Public toolkit descriptions and the complaint-handling guide's seven-step audit and follow-up on printed page 29.
sources.discovery_use: Use a repeatable journey and burden assessment; remeasure after improvements.
sources.limits: The full method-guide form requests an email and was not submitted. No research-site registration was performed. The guide's text was readable, but its screenshot retrieval failed; no chart values or visual scoring scale were extracted.

sources.review_scope: Homepage retrieval attempted; no readable body or individual audit result inspected.
sources.discovery_use: Potential extension for recurring audit findings after inspecting actual results.
sources.limits: Do not claim a specific finding, live menu path or repeated noncompliance from this attempted access.
